title: Edit Reader
connectedResourcesDescription: Select which resources this reader controls. Users tap the reader to unlock the selected resources.
resourcesDescription: Enter resource IDs separated by commas (e.g. 1, 2, 3)
allowPluginBleDescription: When this is on, plugins with the BLE_TRANSPORT permission can scan for nearby Bluetooth devices of the kinds they support and connect to the devices they have set up. Turning it off immediately ends their Bluetooth connections through this reader.
